_README: Skills-only by default: this plugin contributes the three skills and uses whichever ioBroker MCP server you ALREADY have registered (e.g. a user-scope `iobroker` entry in ~/.claude.json). There is intentionally no active `mcpServers` block here, so installing the plugin never double-registers or breaks. To bundle a backend WITH the plugin instead, copy one of the templates below up into a top-level "mcpServers" key. See README for details. Skills are written backend-agnostically — full tool mapping in docs/tool-mapping.md.
